items.headline: Albemarle reports Q3 adjusted EPS $2.58, consensus $2.53
items.snippet: Reports Q3 revenue $1.6B, consensus $1.57B. Global lithium demand is up 48% year-to-date though August, driven by both electric vehicles and energy storage, reinforcing our confidence in the long-term outlook for the industry.

items.headline: ALBEMARLE CORP files FORM 10-Q for Q3, FY 2026 on Nov 4, 2026
items.snippet: Energy Storage net sales and profitability are strongly dependent on lithium market prices, which are volatile. Due to the increased average lithium pricing for 2026, we expect Energy Storage net sales and profitability to increase year-over-year.
